1v0gi4s:360: The integration solution uses a clear dual-component architecture. Agent Core Browser Session Manager is responsible for starting and managing remote browser sessions, creating independent sandbox environments to ensure isolation between multiple tasks; Agent Core Browser Tool encapsulates a rich set of browser operation interfaces (browse_url, search_web, extract_content, fill_form, execute_script, etc.) and exposes them to Dify as tools. This separation of responsibilities brings several key advantages: first, Session Manager hides the complexity of the underlying browser lifecycle; second, the Tool component follows Dify's tool specifications and can be used directly in Workflow and Agent nodes; third, the orthogonal design of session and operations allows the same browser session to be reused by multiple Tool operations, improving execution efficiency in multi-step scenarios.
